summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all core requirements: cartesian product generation, include/exclude rules, fail-fast/max-parallel configuration, matrix size validation, JSON output, and GitHub Actions workflow integration. Well-separated into structure validation (Workflow.Structure.Tests.ps1), unit tests (EnvironmentMatrixGenerator.Tests.ps1), and integration tests via act (Workflow.Execution.Tests.ps1). Strengths: exhaustive testing of rule application logic, proper error cases for each function, act-driven end-to-end validation with exact output assertions, clear test organization. Gaps: limited multi-dimensional cartesian testing (only 1D and 2D), some combinations not exercised (e.g., 3D products, multiple excludes together, include on empty matrix), JSON serialization only tested for compact form, partial config validation. Integration tests have minor brittleness in regex capture (`.*` greedy matching) and depend on single act run completing; fixture files referenced but not shown in provided code. Would reliably catch most regressions but could miss edge cases in complex rule interactions.
